Not financial advice. Capitol Tape displays publicly available U.S. congressional stock trade disclosures (STOCK Act data) for information only. It is not financial, investment or trading advice, and nothing on this site or in the extension is a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Disclosures may be delayed up to 45 days after a trade and may be incomplete or wrong; verify with the official House and Senate filings. See Data & Disclaimers.

Capitol Tape is not affiliated with or endorsed by TradingView, Robinhood, Webull, Charles Schwab, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Fidelity, E*TRADE, Vanguard, Public, Bargo, Google, GitHub, Mozilla, the U.S. Congress or any government entity. All trademarks belong to their owners.
